office_does: A King County District Court judge hears misdemeanor criminal cases, small claims, traffic cases, and protection orders, and is elected by voters in the electoral district to a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Michelle Gehlsen is the only candidate for this position and is running as the incumbent.

candidates.summary: Incumbent King County District Court judge since 2019 who previously spent 10 years as Presiding Judge of Bothell Municipal Court, per her pamphlet statement.
highlights: Judge for more than 16 years, including 10 as Bothell Municipal Court Presiding Judge [S1]
Has presided over Redmond Community Court and founded Bothell Youth Court [S1]
Reports serving as President of the Washington District and Municipal Court Judges' Association [S1]
